description: Track A scoreboard: the biggest lead the mid-training edit ever had over plain training, and the lead left at the end. Units differ per row.

rows.metric: held-out accuracy, points (Opus edit minus no edit)
rows.derived: peak = max over common logged steps of (opus - unedited); final = opus at +60k minus unedited at its stop (95%); mean of 3 seeds

rows.metric: GSM-Symbolic sampled accuracy, points (B minus A)
rows.derived: mean over seeds 0,1 of B-A at eval steps 0/15/30/50/100; peak = max, final = step 100

rows.metric: validation loss, nats (no edit minus Opus edit; + = edit better)
rows.derived: probe val loss every 25 steps; steps ahead = first no-edit step reaching the edited run's loss, minus the edited run's step (searched over edited-run steps <= 3,000)

rows.metric: test accuracy, points (Opus edit minus no edit)
rows.derived: mean over 3 seeds of (agent - none) per probe, averaged over the RESULTS.md head-start windows (single probes swing by +-3 points); peak = best window, final = step 4,000
